scope.load: Global lateral tip force 1 kip; prescribed compressive force ratio times the elastic critical load. Artificially high strength keeps every probe elastic. Large axial area makes shortening negligible for the bending reference.
scope.paths: Constant compression preload then lateral push; simultaneous axial/lateral ramp. 2/4/8 explicit members; 20/100/400 steps. Signed/zero lateral, XY/YZ and translated-origin controls.
scope.references: Independent closed-form cantilever solution of EI*w(4) + N*w(2) = 0, cross-checked against a state-transfer solution; independent Gauss-integrated Hermite bending/geometric energy.
scope.gates: Elastic relative displacement-field error <0.1%; deformed-lever-arm moment residual <0.012 kip-in for the 1 kip, 120 in reference. Controls and reference backward errors are separate checks. No tolerance is relaxed for a candidate.
scope.diagnostic: The half-axial ramp approaches an incomplete compliance integral rather than the static equilibrium field. Isolated half-axial patch only while the raw engine is in Pushover mode, restoring Member3D.kg on every exit. It is not used by Brecon and is not a complete solver correction.
scope.meaning: diagnostic_checks_passed means reference/control checks succeeded, not that the raw candidate qualified. Even an elastic pass would still need yielding, unloading, interaction, stability and accepted-step validation before production.
